jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.company: Mittwald CM Service GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Schaust du in den Spiegel und siehst das lebende Beispiel für gute Kommunikation, Konzeption und lösungsorientiertes Denken? Dann bist du hier richtig - erst recht, wenn du in der IT-Welt zu Hause bist und dich mit Web-Technologien auskennst. In der nächsten Zeit wollen wir ein neues Entwicklerteam aufbauen – und du könntest eine Schlüsselrolle darin spielen. Wenn du Bock hast, mit uns gemeinsam die Agenturwelt mit innovativen digitalen Produkten zu begeistern, melde dich!
 
 Das erwartet dich: 
 Die Sammlung und Priorisierung von Anforderungen sowie die Definition von Lösungskonzepten mit deinem Team

 Du trägst die Verantwortung für die Erstellung und Pflege des Product Backlogs

 Du koordinierst den Entwicklungsprozess und steuerst die Umsetzung der Anforderungen 

 Während des gesamten Prozesses begleitest und unterstützt du dein Entwicklungsteam 

 Märkte und relevante Wettbewerber hast du stets im Blick und verstehst, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen und was sie zukünftig begeistert

 Als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren verschiedenen Teams bist du der erste Ansprechpartner bei Fragen und gibst regelmäßig Updates zum derzeitigen Projektstatus

 
 Das bieten wir dir:
 Sicherheit & Perspektive 
 Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.
 
 Geek paradise 
 Egal ob Kubernetes, Microservices oder React - bei uns kannst du das richtig nice Zeug machen. Damit du dein Bestes geben kannst, bist du der Admin auf deinem Gerät und hast die freie Wahl bei deiner Hardware und der Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
 Aktiver Teil der Community 
 Wir sind Teil der Open Source und Linux Community. Teile unseres Stacks stellen wir zur freien Verfügung, entwickeln von uns genutzte Open Source Projekte aktiv weiter und sponsern Projekte und Events im Open Source Kontext. Und wir unterstützen deine Community-Arbeit.
 Deine Entwicklung 
 Wir wollen, dass du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Dabei unterstützen wir dich aktiv durch Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und unser Coaching-Angebot. Du siehst ein spannendes Thema, das dich und uns voranbringt? Dann nimm dir die Zeit, dich damit zu beschäftigen.
 Dein Einfluss 
 Mitdenker gesucht! Wir geben deinen Ideen Raum und sind offen für Neues. So entwickeln wir uns als Unternehmen stetig weiter. Du möchtest was bewegen? Bring dich ein und lass deinen Gedanken freien Raum. Wir leben echte Mitbestimmung - unabhängig von Rolle und Titel.
 Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden 
 Du kannst dich auf Angebote rund um deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit (wie Sportnavi, aktive Pause, etc.), unser Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits freuen. Natürlich ist bei uns auch für Vitamine, Koffein & H2O gesorgt.
 

 Das bringst du mit: 
 Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium der Fachrichtung (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder einen vergleichbaren Background

 Du konntest idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Rolle als Produktmanager/ Product Owner im agilen Umfeld und im Umgang mit Projektmanagementmethoden sammeln 

 Du bist technisch affin und kannst durch deine bisherigen Kenntnisse auf Augenhöhe mit den Entwicklerteams sprechen

 In Wörtern wie teamfähig, engagiert und qualitätsbewusst erkennst du dich wieder 

 Dir fällt es leicht die Kundenbrille aufzusetzen und hierbei weder die Kundenbedürfnisse noch die Unternehmensziele aus den Augen zu verlieren

 Kontaktperson: Robert Lipkowski

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) MarTech, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben Zahlen, Tools und der Blick dahinter: Du machst sichtbar, was im Marketing wirkt. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Dashboards und unseres MarTech-Stacks, hältst Marketingdaten nachvollziehbar und unterstützt bei ersten KI-gestützten Automatisierungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit klaren Datenregeln, unter Anleitung und in Abstimmung mit Marketing, Vertrieb, IT und Datenschutz. Wenn dich reizt, wie aus Kanaldaten belastbare Entscheidungen werden, bist du hier richtig.
 Das erwartet dich. 

Reporting & Dashboards
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege von Dashboards und kanalspezifischen Kennzahlen auf Basis von Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads und LinkedIn. Du stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen mit einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik gekennzeichnet sind und die verwendeten Definitionen dokumentiert werden. 
 Du bereitest die monatlichen Marketingkennzahlen auf, prüfst Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität und hilfst, verlässliche Ausgangswerte sowie Trends je Kanal zu etablieren. Abweichungen und Datenlücken dokumentierst du und stimmst sie mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern ab.
  
Analyse & Optimierung
 Du bist analytische Ansprechperson für die Performance unserer Kanäle und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Optimierungen ab.
 Du unterstützt bei einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik, prüfst Kampagnenkennzeichnungen regelmäßig und dokumentierst Änderungen, Annahmen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.
 Du bereitest Insights verständlich für das Team auf und erstellst kurze Anleitungen oder Einführungen für wiederkehrende Reports und Tools. Bei komplexen oder systemkritischen Themen arbeitest du mit den zuständigen Expert:innen zusammen.
 Du unterstützt dabei, unsere Sichtbarkeit in ausgewählten KI-Antworten und KI-Suchen systematisch zu beobachten. Du dokumentierst Suchanfragen, Ergebnisse und Veränderungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team erste Hypothesen und Content-Maßnahmen ab.
 
 MarTech & Automatisierung
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres MarTech-Stacks. Dazu gehören die strukturierte Dokumentation eingesetzter Analytics- und Automatisierungstools, die Prüfung von Anforderungen sowie vorbereitende Tests und Abstimmungen für Systemanbindungen. Technische Architektur und produktive Änderungen erfolgen mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau der Marketing-Datenanbindung an unser CRM, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Vertriebsteam und unter Einhaltung der Datenschutzvorgaben.
 Du unterstützt bei der Pflege und Qualitätssicherung unseres Trackings und Remarketings im Rahmen der freigegebenen Konzepte. Dabei dokumentierst du Messpunkte, prüfst die technische Funktion und meldest Abweichungen. Alle Maßnahmen erfolgen unter Beachtung der geltenden Datenschutz- und Einwilligungsvorgaben sowie in Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Konzipieren, Testen und Dokumentieren erster KI-gestützter Automatisierungen für wiederkehrende Marketingabläufe – unter Anleitung, mit klaren Datenregeln und definierten Freigaben. Du prüfst die Ergebnisse vor der Nutzung und entwickelst keine Automatisierungen, die ungeprüft externe Kommunikation auslösen oder sensible Daten verarbeiten.

 Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Daten, Technologie und Marketing sinnvoll zusammenspielen.
 Erste praktische Erfahrung aus Praktika, Hochschulprojekten, studentischen Initiativen oder ehrenamtlichem Engagement ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, dich in verschiedene Themen einzuarbeiten.

 Du arbeitest sicher mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1).
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und selbstständig und hast Lust, dich in MarTech, neue Tools und KI-gestütztes Arbeiten einzuarbeiten.
 Du arbeitest gern mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen zusammen und bist kommunikationsstark.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building. If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

The Guest Revenue tribe owns the products that help hotels earn more from every guest interaction: our booking engine, upselling tools, ancillary revenue features, and the guest recognition layer that makes personalization possible. You'll sit directly alongside Diana Arizmendi (Director of Product and Engineering) as her right hand on the tribe's hardest product problems: improving upsell attach rates (currently ~2%), scaling guest recognition, and shipping the Reputation Manager into GA. You won't be running discovery yourself for every feature — instead, you'll own the tribe's product context and encode your product judgment into the agents, evals, and shared systems that the Product Builders draw on autonomously. When the system doesn't produce the right output, you fix it at the root. When the tribe faces a genuinely ambiguous strategic bet, you own the answer.

What you would do

  • Own the product context your team builds from: the customer evidence, outcome definitions, prioritisation logic and decision history that makes every build decision faster and more grounded.
  • Encode your product thinking into shared tools and systems so that good problem framing and rigorous discovery happen by default, not through constant oversight.
  • Lead discovery on the team's hardest open questions, from improving how guests discover and accept offers to building the data layer that makes guest recognition reliable at scale.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Product and Engineering on complex strategic calls, cross functional alignment and the decisions that have the most long term leverage.
  • Collaborate with Staff Engineers and Staff Designers to make sure product decisions hold up technically and create experiences guests actually notice.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role, that means you design the agents and shared workflows your product builders use to turn customer evidence into decisions, not just use AI tools yourself. You build an approach to discovery and context management that others on the team can pick up and run with on their own, and you are the one who checks whether an AI generated recommendation actually holds up before it shapes a commercial decision.

Join GROPYUS and lead the development of a world-class cost optimization function for our building systems. Working at the intersection of product development, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and construction, you will drive cost competitiveness across the entire building lifecycle.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are
 Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.
 Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.
 For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.
 Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.
 We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.
 Today, Lemrock is already:
 100M+ conversations per month

 150+ brand clients

 a $100B market structuring at high speed

 The role
 Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager , you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped.
 You'll start by owning the brand-facing product , and your scope will grow fast from there.
 Your mission
 Shape the vision : bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing.

 Own the roadmap end to end : turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work.

 Run discovery : spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build.

 Ship with the team : work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly.

 Own launches and outcomes : drive rollout, watch the data, onboard the business teams, and judge your work by what it moved, not by what shipped.

 Build the product function itself : the rituals, the prioritization, the feedback loop from the field.

 What we're looking for
 3 to 8 years in product , at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results.

 A generalist comfortable owning the messy middle: discovery one hour, scoping with engineers the next, writing the launch note after that.

 A bias for action : you make calls with incomplete data, ship, and iterate from what real users do.

 Customer obsession that shows up in your decisions.

 AI-native : you already build with tools like Claude, Cursor, v0 or Lovable to prototype, research, synthesize, and move the roadmap faster.

 Able to learn a lot, fast , in a deep and complex environment.

 Fluent French and professional English.

 Based in Paris, with the team at the office (up to 1 day remote per week).

 Bonus
 You've built in e-commerce, marketplaces, adtech, or AI/agent products , or you're genuinely fascinated by agentic commerce.

 A technical background (ex-software engineer or CS), so you can go deep with the team and direct AI tools effectively.

 Why join us
 Join a company in early breakout mode , already generating revenue with a clear edge.

 Be part of the next structural shift of the web : agentic commerce.

 Work directly with experienced, ambitious founders, and own the product from day one.

 Shape both the product and how we build it.

 What we offer
 Competitive salary, based on experience

 Equity (BSPCE)

 Meal vouchers with Swile

 Alan health insurance

 7 weeks of vacation (RTT included)

 50% transportation coverage

jobs.description:
About Gladia 
 Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer. 
 Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR , across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.
 Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).
 Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group. 
 
 We're guided by four values :
 Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

 Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

 Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

 Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

 The role 
 Gladia sells to very different buyers — from developers at AI startups to product and engineering leaders at large voice platforms such as contact centers . We need one clear, sharp story for each of them, and the tools that help our sales team tell it.
 And our portfolio is growing . Since joining OVH Groupe, we're expanding our product offering which means more products to position and new product lines to bring to market. We need an experienced Product Marketing Manager to help us position each of them and launch them successfully.
 As our first Product Marketing Manager , you'll own how Gladia is positioned and how we win. You'll define our messaging by segment, equip our sales team with what they need to close, orchestrate our product launches, and build a real understanding of our market, competitors, and buyers.
 You'll report to our Marketing Lead, with a strong dotted line to Product, and you'll work hand in hand with our Sales team: you'll be close to what we build and why, and you'll bring the voice of the market back into product decisions. Day-to-day, you'll work with AEs, SDRs, RevOps, Product, and Marketing.
 
 What you'll do 
 Positioning & messaging — Define Gladia's positioning and messaging for each customer segment, and keep it consistent across sales, marketing, and product

 Market & user research — Lead market analysis (including TAM sizing) and take part in product and customer interviews, so our positioning and roadmap are grounded in real market insight

 Sales enablement — Build the materials our sales team uses every day: battlecards, one-pagers, objection handling, pitch narratives, and outbound sequence content

 Product launches — Own the go-to-market for product launches, from positioning to launch plan, working across Product, Marketing, and Sales — including writing the key launch content yourself (e.g., the launch blog post)

 Competitive intelligence — Track the competitive landscape and turn it into clear, usable insights for the team

 Win/loss analysis — Set up a structured process to learn from the deals we win and lose, and feed those learnings back into messaging, product, and sales

 Buyer personas — Refine our understanding of our buyers: who they are, what they care about, and how they decide

 
 Who you are 
 5+ years in product marketing , ideally in B2B SaaS, API, or infrastructure companies

 A track record of building positioning and sales enablement that sales teams actually use

 Experience running product launches end-to-end 

 A strong connection with Product: you enjoy working closely with product teams and turning market insight into product input

 Comfortable with technical products — you can understand an API and explain its value to both technical and business buyers

 Structured and analytical: you use data from deals, customers, and the market to back your decisions

 Autonomous, with strong judgment on priorities — you've worked in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

 Excellent writer and communicator, comfortable writing flagship content such as a launch blog post

 Fluent English
 

 Bonus points 
 Experience launching new product lines and overseeing GTM launches end-to-end, based on a clear playbook

 Experience selling to the US market

 Familiarity with speech, audio, or AI/ML products

 
 What Gladia offers 
 The compensation offered is based on seniority and experience, and would typically range from €70K to €90K base salary

 Hybrid work from our offices in the heart of Paris (no compulsory office days)

 Lunch vouchers (approx. 200€/month)

 Health insurance (100% coverage) and a pension contract for you & your family

 Flexible vacation policy

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - F/H
jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.

 
 Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.

 
 Ce que tu fais concrètement : 
 Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier.

 Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus.

 Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre.

 Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment.

 Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes.

 Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi.

 Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

 Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.

 

 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? 
 Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien.

 Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

 Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) 

 Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage.

 Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.
 
 
 Pré-requis du poste 
 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons 
 Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul.

 Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes.

 Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider.

 Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit.

 Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également.

 Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel.

 
 
 Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? 
 Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

 Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

 Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

 Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche

 Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !
 Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog .

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

 

 Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

 Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

 Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! 

 How to Apply 
 Send us your CV, two or three writing or work s

jobs.description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

jobs.description:
Powering Great Work 
 We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:
 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business
 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time
 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country
 As our next Senior Product Manager in Media, you'll lead the development of our advertising products: the ways trades reach homeowners on Checkatrade. You'll improve what's already live, build new products from scratch and help launch an entirely new growth stream for the business. It's a direct line to Powering Great Work: giving trades better ways to win work, and giving homeowners a better way to find the right tradesperson.
 The job, unfiltered: 
 Design new advertising products and upgrade the ones already live, so trades have stronger ways to reach customers.

 Turn user behaviour, market trends and performance data into product decisions that move metrics.

 Work side by side with engineers, designers, data scientists and commercial teams. Get into the detail, ship quickly and solve problems together rather than lobbing tickets over the fence.

 Run experiments all the time: A/B tests, pricing trials, performance tuning and live-data tweaks, to find out what great looks like.

 Drive the launch of a new growth stream for Checkatrade. Your ideas won't sit in a backlog; they'll shape how advertisers connect with customers.

 The fit: 
 Product management experience. You understand how digital experiences work and you're comfortable shaping something new.

 A product-thinking mindset. You can zoom out to spot the opportunity, then turn it into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

 Strong analytical instincts and confidence with experiments, whether that's digging into data or proving (or disproving) an idea.

 A friendly, collaborative way of working with designers, data teams, engineers and commercial partners.

 Clear communication. You can explain the why, bring people with you and make complex ideas easy to follow.

 A bias for action. You're comfortable making smart calls in ambiguous situations and taking ideas from concept to launch.

 Nice to have: a background in Consumer Marketplaces, ad tech or digital marketing.

 (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) 
 What you get 
 💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme
 🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support
 🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme
 🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme
 ❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

 Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

 First interview with our VP, Bookings & New Media

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Product Marketing(x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Als Senior Lead Product Marketing im Medics Cluster arbeitest Du direkt mit, den größten Produktlaunch von Doctolib in Deutschland zu skalieren: Die All-In-One Praxissoftware, mit der Gesundheitsteams Ende zu Ende alle administrativen und klinischen Arbeitsabläufe vor, während und nach dem Termin steuern können. 
Als Teil unseres lokalen Product Marketing Teams handelst Du wie ein CEO für Deinen Bereich: Du entwickelst die Go-to-Market-Strategie in Deutschland weiter und bist verantwortlich für deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung. Dein Hauptziel ist es, durch innovative Marktstrategien die Ziele für ongeboardete Praxen zu erreichen und die Zufriedenheit unserer Nutzer weiter zu erhöhen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und setzt Go-to-Market-Strategien für Doctolib’s Produkt- und Feature-Launches um
  • Als Stimme unserer Nutzer verbesserst Du kontinuierlich unseren Product-Market-Fit und gestaltest unsere Product Roadmap
  • Gleichzeitig stellt Du sicher, dass wir die Signale unsere Nutzer entlang der Customer Journey verstehen und darauf aufbauend kontinuierlich unsere Value Delivery, Usage, Trust und Customer Experience verbessern
  • Du analysierst Markttrends und die Wettbewerbslandschaft, um strategische Chancen zu identifizieren
  • Du definierst die Produktpositionierung und -botschaften für den deutschen Markt
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams Marketing, Sales, Customer Success sowie Product & Tech zusammen
  • Du managst Feature Releases und stellst deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung sicher
  • Gemeinsam mit anderen Teams verfolgst du regulatorische und technische Rahmenbedingungen und arbeitest mit daran, ein Umfeld für kunden- und nutzerfreundliche Lösungen zu schaffen

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

  • Du hast mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise als Manager:in im Product Marketing oder Go-To-Market Strategie, oder mit einem Hintergrund in der Top-Tier-Managementberatung oder VC - kombiniert mit Product Management Erfahrung
  • Du hast eine ausgeprägt strukturierte und analytische Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Du hast bereits eng mit Tech & Product Teams gearbeitet
  • Es fällt Dir leicht, Prioritäten zu setzen, Ressourcen sinnvoll zu allokieren und Projekte strukturiert zu führen, um Go-to-Market Strategien effektiv zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.
  • Du bist erfahren im Management seniorer Stakeholder (VP, MD, Executive Committee)
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln
  • Du sprichst fließend deutsch und englisch (jeweils mindestens C1-Niveau)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up-Unternehmen
  • Erfahrung im Medtech-Bereich

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit) 
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das einen Monat Elternzeit extra u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

  • Recruiter Interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Case Study Interview
  • Finales Interview mit dem VP
  • Referenzen

Job Details

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket
  • Arbeitsort Berlin
  • 2 Tage Homeoffic

Also, we've been awarded by Apple and Google as one of the best apps available. 
 
 
 To improve the training experience our app provides and make the product more effective and engaging to users and patients, we are looking for a passionate person with a background in science and deep interest in digital health and games. Since the role touches many different fields, you don’t have to bring all know-how already with you - we are welcoming passionate learners who want to develop themselves in this role. 
 
 
 So, if you want to help us shape a better tomorrow, join us on our journey! 
 
 
 Your roles and responsibilities 
 
 
 Improve the training experience and the exercises of our mobile and web app by making NeuroNation as effective and engaging as possible

jobs.title: Product Manager*in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lust auf Produktgestaltung und Innovation? 

 Willst du Features bauen oder echte Probleme lösen?

Wir suchen keinen bloßen „Verwalter von Anforderungen“, sondern einen strategischen Kopf, der unser Produkt zum Marktführer macht. Wir sind ein SaaS-Startup mit einer klaren Mission: Mehrweg in der Logistik so einfach wie Einweg zu machen. Wir reduzieren nicht nur den CO₂-Fußabdruck einer ganzen Branche, sondern optimieren einen ihrer nervigsten Prozesse.

 Als Product Manager bist du nicht dafür da, Tickets zu schreiben. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass unser Produkt wertvoll für den Kunden und rentabel für unser Business ist.

 Aufgaben

 
 Product Discovery statt bloßer Ausführung: Du bekommst keine fertigen Lösungen vorgesetzt. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, um herauszufinden, was wir bauen müssen. Du validierst Hypothesen schnell und minimierst das Risiko, Dinge zu bauen, die niemand braucht.

 Outcome über Output: Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an der Anzahl der geschriebenen Tickets oder pünktlichen Releases, sondern an messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen (z.B. Adoption-Rate von Features, Prozess-Effizienz beim Kunden).

 Tiefes Kundenverständnis: Du wirst zum Experten für unsere Nutzer. Durch kontinuierliche User Interviews und Datenanalysen verstehst du deren Schmerzpunkte besser als sie selbst und leitest daraus die Produktstrategie ab.

 Business Viability: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen nicht nur nutzbar sind, sondern auch in unser Geschäftsmodell passen und rechtlich sowie technisch realisierbar sind.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Liebe zum Problem: Du verstehst den Unterschied zwischen Projekt- und Produktmanagement. Du liebst es, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und übernimmst Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deines Produktbereichs.

 Evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen: Du verlässt dich nicht auf Bauchgefühl. Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen Discovery-Methoden (Prototyping, A/B-Testing, Customer Interviews) und weißt, wie man Daten nutzt, um Argumente zu stützen.

 Kollaboration & Kommunikation: Du siehst Entwickler und Designer nicht als "Ressourcen", sondern als Partner. Du kannst Stakeholdern souverän "Nein" sagen, um den Fokus auf das Wesentliche zu wahren, und kannst deine Produktvision begeisternd vermitteln.

 Hintergrund: Ein Studium ist gut, echte Erfahrung ist besser. Ob Informatik, BWL oder Quereinsteiger: Wichtig ist, dass du Erfahrung im Bauen digitaler Produkte (SaaS) hast und idealerweise schon einmal in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld (Startup) gearbeitet hast.

 
 Benefits

 
 Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen.

 Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe,…), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m.

 Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest.

 Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst.

 Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik.

 Wähle die Incentives, die zu dir passen: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass und das Jobrad.

 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

 30 Urlaubstage

 Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.

 
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst du die datenstrategische Grundlage für die digitalen Produkte renommierter Medienmarken. Dabei verbindest du Produktstrategie mit fundierter Datenanalyse und treibst an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Nutzerverständnis die kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Produkte voran.

 Aufgaben

 Produktverantwortung & Strategie: 

 
 Du verantwortest End-to-End unsere Analytics-Tools (z.B. Google Analytics, Marfeel) und die Experimentierinfrastruktur (z.B. A/B-Testing)

 Du entwickelst die Analytics-Roadmap, kommunizierst die Produktvision und steuerst Releases vom ersten Konzept bis zum Go-Live

 
 Zahlen, die zählen: 

 
 Du berätst Fachteams zu relevanten KPIs, erstellst Ad-hoc-Analysen und bist erste Ansprechperson, wenn Metriken erklärungsbedürftig sind

 Du entwickelst Benchmarks und Kennzahlen, die echten Mehrwert für das Entwicklungsteam und Business schaffen

 Du verbindest strategisches Produktdenken mit echter Datenkompetenz und weißt, wann ein Chart eine Entscheidung treibt – und wann er sie verschleiert

 
 KPI-Framework & Customer Tracking: 

 
 Du definierst, implementierst und monitorst KPIs zur Erfolgsmessung von Kundenverhalten entlang der gesamten Journey – von der ersten Interaktion bis zum Abo-Abschluss

 Du identifizierst Reibungspunkte (z. B. im Checkout-Flow), leitest Optimierungs-maßnahmen ab und stellst sicher, dass Features und Produktentscheidungen konsequent auf Kundenbedarf ausgerichtet sind

 
 Experimente & Testing: 

 
 Du formulierst Hypothesen, designst Tests (Onboarding, Landingpages, Pricing, Targeting), wertest Ergebnisse eigenständig aus und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab – ohne auf ein dediziertes Data-Team angewiesen zu sein

 
 Backlog & Anforderungen: 

 
 Du übersetzt Business-, Daten- und Nutzerbedürfnisse in saubere Epics, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien

 Du priorisierst das Backlog gemeinsam mit dem Product-Team und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Velocity und Time-to-Market stimmen

 Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für das Entwicklungsteam und verantwortest die technische Umsetzung relevanter Features

 
 Stakeholder-Brücke: 

 
 Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Technologie

 Du moderierst Anforderungen, bewertest Impact und stellst sicher, dass technische Umsetzungen mit der Produktstrategie übereinstimmen – verständlich für alle Beteiligten

 
 Markt & Trends: 

 
 Du behältst Branchenentwicklungen, neue Technologien und sich wandelnde Nutzererwartungen im Blick und übersetzt sie in priorisierte Produktempfehlungen

 
 Qualifikation

 
 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager – idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Data Analytics oder Product Analytics

 Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, BWL, Medieninformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich – oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung

 Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Steuerung agiler Teams (Scrum/Kanban) und im eigenständigen Anforderungsmanagement

 Verständnis für Datenvisualisierung und den Aufbau aussagekräftiger Dashboards

 Fundiertes Verständnis von Data Governance, datengetriebenen Entscheidungen und dem Aufbau skalierbarer Metriken

 Du kannst Daten in klare Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzen – für technische wie nicht-technische Zielgruppen gleichermaßen

 Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wechselst mühelos zwischen Kontexten und packst dort an, wo du gebraucht wirst

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

 
 VON VORTEIL

 
 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten im Verlagswesen, Medien oder E-Commerce

 Hintergrund in der Softwareentwicklung

 Kenntnisse in UX-Prinzipien und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX/UI-Design-Teams

 
 Benefits

 
 Gestaltungsfreiheit und Verantwortung: Du erhältst echten Freiraum, unsere digitalen Produkte, Workflows und Formate aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

 Tätigkeit mit Relevanz: Die Chance, an einem journalistisch anspruchsvollen Projekt mitzuwirken und publizistische Wirkung sichtbar zu entfalten

 Sichere Perspektive: Unbefristete Anstellung mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit und einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung

 Arbeiten im Herzen Berlins: Modernes Büro direkt am Alexanderplatz mit beeindruckendem Blick über die Stadt und sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung

 Wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur: Eine offene, kollegiale Atmosphäre, in der individuelle Perspektiven zählen und Teamarbeit gelebt wird

 Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Entwicklungsperspektiven und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung auszubauen und neue Kompetenzen zu entwickeln

jobs.title: Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
jobs.description:
Withings est une entreprise française pionnière de la santé connectée. Depuis 2008, nous concevons des produits et services qui permettent à chacun de mieux comprendre sa santé et aux professionnels de santé de mieux accompagner leurs patients.
 Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin.
 Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux.
 
 Vos responsabilités 
 Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.
 Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques. 
 Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient.
 Imaginer des parcours patients favorisant l'engagement, l'éducation thérapeutique et l'adoption de comportements favorables à leur santé.
 Définir la vision produit, les priorités et la roadmap en collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
 Définir et suivre les KPI permettant de mesurer l'utilisation et l'impact réel des fonctionnalités développées.
 Étudier le marché, les usages et les évolutions du secteur de la santé digitale afin d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
 Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement.
 Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit.
 Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur.
 L'objectif n'est pas seulement de produire des spécifications mais d'être capable de rendre rapidement une idée tangible, afin de mieux collaborer avec les utilisateurs, les designers et les ingénieurs.
 Requirements 
 Profil recherché 
 Formation Bac+5, idéalement école d'ingénieur ou formation scientifique/technique équivalente.
 Environ 3 ans d'expérience ou plus, idéalement dans un environnement produit ou technologique exigeant.
 Solide culture technique et réelle envie de comprendre comment les produits fonctionnent.
 Forte sensibilité produit et design : capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à concevoir des expériences intuitives.
 Maîtrise des outils d'IA générative, notamment pour créer rapidement des prototypes, développer des fonctionnalités ou automatiser certaines tâches.
 Capacité à prototyper et à manipuler des outils techniques ; savoir coder ou avoir déjà développé des projets personnels est un vrai plus.
 Intérêt marqué pour la santé, la médecine, la santé digitale et les nouvelles technologies.
 Forte capacité analytique et aptitude à utiliser la donnée pour prendre des décisions produit.
 Excellente capacité à collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires : Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
 Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement rapide où de nombreux sujets restent à inventer.
 Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
 Benefits 
 Rejoindre l'aventure Withings, c'est : 
 Intégrer l'un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronics Show.
 Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux visant à construire la santé de demain.
 Travailler dans un environnement international avec des équipes basées notamment à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong et Shenzhen.
 Participer directement à l'amélioration de nos produits et services, notamment en les testant avant leur lancement.
 Approfondir ses connaissances médicales grâce à la Withings Med Academy et aux interventions régulières de professionnels de santé.
 Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, restaurant d'entreprise, avantages culturels et sportifs, et bien plus encore.
 Et surtout, rejoindre des équipes passionnées qui cherchent à avoir un impact concret sur la manière dont la santé sera suivie et prise en charge demain.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based at our Geneva, Switzerland office, with the option to work two days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 10%
Job ID: 1771

The Role: 

As a Product Manager within the Quantum Platform – Devices division, you will play a key role in supporting a growing portfolio of cutting-edge products by taking ownership of day-to-day product operations. You will ensure product features are clearly defined, tracked throughout every stage of the product lifecycle and delivered successfully across cross-functional teams. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing, you will translate market and customer insights into product features for refinement by engineering teams, while leading the triage, planning and coordination of special customer projects. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.
    • Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.
    • Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.
    • Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. You will own high-stakes client engagements end-to-end, bringing deep project management expertise to solve problems on the ground and drive customer outcomes with minimal oversight.

About You 
As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organisation, you will drive impact primarily through hands-on delivery excellence, leadership, and practice enablement.

1. Client Delivery Excellence
● Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
● Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
● Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies, resolving issues autonomously before they escalate.
● Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales), and third- party partners.
● Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.

2. PMO & Process Optimisation
● Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
● Continuous Improvement: Flag bottlenecks and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
● Assist in establishing best practices for your engagements, resource allocation, utilisation tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.

Required Qualifications:
● 8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organisation.
● Previous experience with managing customers from Financial Services, Government, Healthcare industries
● Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
● Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, exercising strong judgment and decision-making in ambiguous, high-pressure customer situations.
● Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
● Fluent written and spoken German and English skill is a must.
● Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

● Technical Background: Prior hands-on experience or foundational knowledge in Data Management, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data Protection, Enterprise Storage, Cybersecurity, or SaaS delivery is a strong plus.
● Financial acumen regarding professional services metrics (e.g., revenue recognition, margin, utilization, project profitability).
● Experience contributing to PMO governance practices.

About the Team 
Rubrik Professional Services transforms possibilities into outcomes. Our portfolio of services uncovers and exploits the unique opportunities made possible by Rubrik technology. Drawing on our unparalleled product expertise and customer experiences, we collaborate with customers to identify and address complex technical challenges, improve operational efficiency, and maximize their investment in Rubrik. We are 100% focused on customer success, operational excellence, and empowering our team members to grow, lead, and innovate.

  • Track product performance and use data to identify what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it
  • Develop expertise in the onboarding domain and stay curious about how our product, customers, and landscape evolve

  • Drive through effective and sustainable change and guide the business through the journey.
  • Play an integral role in a self-organizing agile delivery team, ensuring solutions adhere to state regulations for our products while serving the needs of each of our products (Sportsbook, Fantasy Sports, Predicts, Racing, and Casino).
  • Understand and communicate the problem whilst putting the customers experience of the product first.

What We’re Looking For

    • Comfortable managing priorities and working through ambiguity
    • Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

 

What You Can Expect

  • A sense of achievement - Our teams own their own software and when that awesome new feature ships to users and the positive feedback starts rolling in, you can feel really proud of what you and your team created

 Requirements
 Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

 Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.
 The team 
 Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
 Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
 The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
 The opportunity 
 Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

 Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

 Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

 Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

 Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

 Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

 Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

 Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

  
  
 What you bring 
 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

 Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

 Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

 Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

 Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

 Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

 Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

  
  
 Nice to haves 
 Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

 Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

 Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

 Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

 Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. 
 We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. 
 
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. 
 But that’s just the beginning: 
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. 
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. 
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
