In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
 

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level french speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
 
 How to Apply 
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

 Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

 Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

 Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

 

 Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

 Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

 Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer (a)
jobs.description:
Über uns MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

 Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.

 Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
 AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
 AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
 Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.
 

 Das bringst du mit Du hast einen  belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software .

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members across UK and India
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

Ongoing Monitoring is building the capabilities Tide needs to detect, prevent and manage financial crime, fraud and risk across the member lifecycle.

Within Ongoing Monitoring, we are creating a new Acquiring Fraud & Risk team as part of the Ongoing Monitoring team. This team will focus on protecting Tide’s growing Merchant Acquiring business by reducing acquiring fraud, chargeback losses and operational risk across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

Merchant Acquiring is a fast-growing product within Tide. We are on a mission to provide the simplest and easiest ways for our members to get paid. As we scale Acquiring globally, we need strong monitoring capabilities that protect Tide from avoidable losses while keeping the experience smooth for genuine members.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Senior Product Manager for Ongoing Monitoring Acquiring Fraud & Risk, you will own the roadmap for Tide’s acquiring transaction risk monitoring capabilities.

Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Operations, Risk and Acquiring Product teams, you will build and scale real-time monitoring solutions using rules engines, machine learning models and Agentic AI to reduce fraud losses, improve chargeback outcomes and manage Tide’s acquiring risk exposure across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning and independently defining the product strategy, vision and roadmap for acquiring fraud and risk monitoring within Ongoing Monitoring
  • Building scalable monitoring capabilities across card-present and card-not-present acquiring journeys
  • Working with Engineering and Data Science teams to define and deliver real-time rules, risk signals, machine learning models and decisioning workflows
  • Having end-to-end ownership of the acquiring fraud and risk monitoring product development lifecycle
  • Prioritising product work based on risk reduction, commercial impact, operational effort, member experience and technical feasibility
  • Creating clear product narratives for senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams

Data-Driven Product Development & Acquiring Fraud Reduction

You will be responsible for:

  • Using data to identify acquiring fraud patterns, merchant behaviour, loss drivers and control gaps
  • Developing product capabilities that actively reduce acquiring fraud losses and help keep Tide within relevant card scheme thresholds
  • Establishing and monitoring performance metrics such as fraud loss rate, chargeback rate, scheme exposure, false positive rate and operational efficiency
  • Running experiments and targeted control changes to improve fraud prevention while minimising friction for genuine members
  • Working with Finance, Risk and Operations teams to quantify the commercial impact of fraud and risk controls

Chargeback Management and Operational Risk

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - UK
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
  

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level english speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our London office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
  
 How to Apply 
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

 Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Product & Engineering
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you’ll do 
 Run the operating cadence for Product & Engineering: own planning cycles, roadmap workflows, initiative tracking, sprint planning, and team initiatives

 Design and optimize key processes like product reviews, retrospectives, team syncs, and engineering demos to drive clarity and velocity

 Build and maintain operational artifacts such as roadmaps, planning docs, capacity trackers, dashboards, and retros that keep everyone informed and aligned

 Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that span Product, Eng, Design, Brand, Sales, and Ops teams—driving alignment, timelines, and accountability

 Partner with product, eng and marketing leads to create scalable frameworks for goal-setting (e.g., OKRs), prioritization, and execution

 Analyze operational data and team feedback to identify friction points and implement systems that improve execution and outcomes

 Build our internationalization operations playbook and continuously improve it so we can scale with quality and intention

 What you’ll bring 
 6-8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, or Program Management in a high-growth, product-led company

 Proven track record building and scaling operational processes from scratch

 Highly organized and methodical; you bring rigor, structure, and momentum to ambiguous situations

 Excellent written and verbal communicator—clear, succinct, and persuasive across stakeholders and levels

 Comfortable using tools like Linear, Figma, Google Drive, or similar to create systems that stick

 Strong analytical instincts with proficiency in Excel/Sheets; SQL or dashboard experience is a plus

 Even better… 
 Experience at an early-stage startup or scaling product org

 Familiarity with OKR frameworks, roadmap tools, or product analytics platforms

 Background in product management, engineering, or consulting/strategy with deep operational exposure

 Experience with vendor management and localization expansion efforts

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Software
jobs.description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid 

Salary: £75,000 to £95,000, DOE  

 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.  

 

About the role 

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager with a background in science or engineering and quantum computing or HPC experience to help define and grow an important part of Riverlane’s software product portfolio.

This is an early-stage, fast-moving area of our product roadmap: you’ll help shape its direction as much as run what already exists.

You’ll sit right at the heart of this product area, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most.

You’ll own and evolve the strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision, striking the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today.

This role sits close to the centre of Riverlane, working daily with colleagues across Engineering, Science and the PMO. We ask for three days a week in our Cambridge office to make that collaboration easy.

This role involves quarterly travel, less than 10% of your time, to conferences such as IEEE and to visit customers.

 

What you will do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, stakeholder input and Riverlane’s strategic direction
  • Engage with customers, partners and internal teams to build a complete picture of market needs and the competitive landscape
  • Use product usage data, market insight and competitive analysis to prioritise features and drive adoption
  • Align stakeholders across the C-suite, research, engineering, business development and marketing, and identify new market opportunities for Riverlane
  • Support go-to-market execution and launch readiness with Marketing and Business Development, including external collateral and documentation
  • Monitor delivery progress and adapt plans as new challenges or opportunities emerge

 

What we need

  • A background in engineering or science (degree or equivalent experience)
  • 4+ years in B2B product management
  • Experience in a HPC or quantum computing, translating complex technical trade-offs into product decisions
  • High emotional intelligence, with strong active listening and critical thinking skills
  • A collaborative, cross-functional team player who can influence without authority and build trust across teams
  • Ease with going technically deep, both internally and externally, to understand product capabilities and limitations
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving, ambiguous and rapidly evolving environment

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators

We're excited about you because…

  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system

  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Comms Platform
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the next generation of Affirm’s Comms Plat. The opportunity spans two connected areas: (1) Modernizing the platform that powers critical transactional communications across channels; (2) Building shared capabilities that help Affirm create a more coordinated experience across marketing and transactional comms. Together, this work will simplify how teams build and manage communications, strengthen the reliability and scalability of our systems, and help us deliver more relevant and consistent customer experiences.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and teams across Product, Marketing, Ops, Design, Analytics, and Legal and Compliance to set product direction and turn it into capabilities teams can successfully adopt. You’ll navigate complex technical and business tradeoffs, balance near-term needs with longer-term platform investments, and help determine where Affirm should build capabilities directly versus work with third-party partners.

 

What you'll do 

  • Set product strategy and roadmap for Comms Plat, connecting customer needs, business priorities, and technical opportunities.

  • Help modernize Affirm’s comms infrastructure and build shared capabilities that support more consistent experiences across transactional and marketing comms.

  • Lead complex platform initiatives from strategy through launch and adoption, working closely with Engineering and cross-functional partners.

  • Build strong relationships across Affirm so communications needs for new products, markets, and customer journeys are understood early and reflected in platform plans.

  • Shape channel, platform, and partner strategy, including thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions across the communications ecosystem.

  • Make clear tradeoffs across customer experience, reliability, scalability, cost, regulatory requirements, and speed.

  • Define meaningful measures of success and use customer, product, operational, and business signals to guide priorities and investment.

 

What we look for

  • 8+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience, with a track record of leading complex products or platforms.

  • Experience building platform or other technically complex products. Comms or messaging experience is helpful, but not required.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into a clear strategy and actionable roadmap.

  • Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with Engineering on architecture, reliability, scalability, and platform tradeoffs.

  • A track record of taking products beyond launch and driving adoption across multiple teams or customer groups.

  • Strong cross-functional influence and the ability to build alignment across teams with different priorities and constraints.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, including the ability to weigh customer impact, operating complexity, cost, and risk when making decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics understandable and bring stakeholders along in the decision-making process.

  • A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay focused on the experience the platform ultimately creates, even when working deep in infrastructure.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, using judgment and available information to move work forward while adapting as you learn.

 

This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.

We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager to own the Go-To-Market for one of DeepL’s core product areas.

You will act as a strategic thinker who distills market insights and competitive analysis into a clear vision, collaborating closely with product development, sales, and customer success to ensure the successful launch and ongoing promotion of our capabilities within the platform.

jobs.description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.
 
 We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub.  CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

 Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 
 Location: EU 
 (Remote) 
 
 Who You’ll Work For: 
 
 At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 
 We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 
 
 Who we're looking for: 
 
 As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 
 This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location. 
 
 The role: 
 
 Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

 Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

 Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

 Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

 Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

 Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

 Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 

 
 Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

 Background in Electronics/Electricals 

 Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

 Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

 Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

 Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

 Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

 A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

 Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

 Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 
 What We Offer: 
 
 Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

 Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

 Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

 Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 
 The Experience: 
 
 Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

 Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.

 The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

 Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.
 ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.
 Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.
 You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.
 Your day-to-day  
 Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
 Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
 Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
 Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
 Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
 Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
 Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
 Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
 Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
 Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.
 

 Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.
 You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
 You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
 You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
 You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
 You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.

jobs.title: Product Manager - EXOtube
jobs.description:
Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across  48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube . Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager  is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand. 

 Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany . The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. 

 Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . 

 Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. 

 Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. 

 Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. 

 Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. 

 Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. 

 Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . 

 Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. 

 Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level 

 Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. 

 

 Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 

 5+ years of engineering work experience. 

 Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. 

 Excellent written and spoken English. 

 Excellent technical communication skills. 

 Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. 

 Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design. 

 Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting. 

 Ability to work in a fast-paced and demanding environment. 

 Flexibility for travel, occasionally at short notice 

 

 Why us? Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities 

 Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility 

 Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere 

 State-of-the-art Office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz 

 Access to an in-house gym at the HQ 

 All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively 

 Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment 

 Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events 

 

 Travel Expectations The position requires flexibility for regular travel, including short-notice trips. You should be comfortable with traveling approximately at 10-15% of your work time. 

 Location Requirement This role is based in Berlin. Candidates must either currently reside in Berlin or be open to relocating.
